findings.title: Direct LLM API client invocations bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct call_gemini and call_mistral invocations using environment API keys rather than routing via model router port 8891

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to query the centralized model-router endpoint instead of invoking provider SDKs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized model governance, rate limiting, and observability for intelligence alerts.
